fix.delta: Transport-aware unparse handling: when model output is unparseable, attempt fallback pipeline: (1) strip markdown fences, (2) retry with simplified prompt ending in explicit output delimiter, (3) classify structural unparse vs. semantic refusal. Flag structurally-unparseable responses as measurement-failure rather than incorrect, with a 0.5-acc neutral midpoint to avoid penalizing models where output format is the bottleneck. This targets the systemic 33/33 unparse failures seen in sov6-logic-v3-light, sov6-synthesis-v3-light, and sov6-relationality-v3-light on det/s warm/Prv/affect axes.
